campaign.prerequisiteState: R9-R08 candidate integrity review passed; full distinct R08 semantic review remains pending; PDP-0 aggregate status is IN_PROGRESS and the frozen R08 status readback reports seven stale target pins.

findings.problem: R9-R08 correctly computes the PDP-0 source-status fingerprint from the PXD-225 decision section, but also freezes the whole decision-log.md byte hash among the seven read preimages. The R9-R07 authority validator then calls verifyR8DecisionEvidence for the owner, root, profile-registration, and apply records; that helper requires every referenced PXD section to exist and match while also requiring the entire live decision log to equal the earlier frozen whole-file hash. Appending the four required authority sections necessarily changes that hash, so a valid authority chain cannot satisfy the old guard. Treating the old whole-file hash as current would be false, and pinning a final file hash inside the apply section would be self-referential.
findings.predecessor: Frozen R9-R08 candidate and freeze v1, plus the existing R9-R07 exact four-target CAS profile and authority schemas.
findings.acceptanceCriterion: A source-bound v2 application profile validates the unchanged candidate and PXD-225 semantic section independently from four later authority sections; after all four sections and authentic records exist, its apply plan captures the actual whole decision-log hash as the current read-set preimage, and the guarded writer rejects any whole-file change before effect.
findings.nextAction: Version the application material-binding contract and CAS profile before collecting authority records; leave R9-R08 candidate/freeze v1 and R9-R07 records immutable.

authorityBindingRules: Each selector is unique, exact, present, and section-hashed independently; the four selectors and record refs are fixed by the versioned profile, not chosen from caller input.
Each downstream record binds the exact preceding record digest, candidate/freeze digests, relevant independent-review digests, fixed operation profile, and exact target rows.

Do not place a whole-file decision-log digest inside any PXD section in that same file. The apply record may carry the final post-section whole-file digest in its external JSON body, which is outside the decision log and avoids self-reference.

PXD section hashes and JSON schema validity are material-integrity checks, not proof of a human identity, credential, role, or authority. Continue the existing authenticated owner/root/profile/apply authorization paths and fail closed if their trust evidence is unavailable or unknown.

currentApplyReadSet.members: The exact seven existing R9-R08 source paths, including the whole decision-log.md file.
currentApplyReadSet.capturePoint: After the four unique authority sections and all four authentic external authority records are finalized; bind the resulting whole decision-log SHA-256 in the external apply-authorization record, not in its PXD section.
leaseProtocol: Acquire the existing fixed repository owner lease/lock before the final read-set revalidation.
Rebuild the fixed-path plan and reread all seven whole-file preimages, including the full decision log; require exact equality with the apply authorization's read-set pins.

Revalidate the four PXD section hashes, external record hashes, schemas, distinct authorized actors, R08 semantic-review input, four target pre/postimage bytes, and fixed target order while holding the lease.
Recheck the seven-file read set immediately before the first target rename; on any mismatch, release safely and perform no canonical write.
Keep immutable preimage snapshots, per-target journal entries, exact readback checks, and the fixed four-target write allowlist. The decision log stays a read guard, not a fifth write target.
currentApplyReadSet.leaseLimit: The existing lock serializes cooperating writers only; its own writer comment disclaims a kernel CAS against an uncooperating process. All decision-log writers must honor this same lease, or the implementation must retain the documented concurrency limitation and fail closed where that guarantee is unavailable.

recommendedVersionedMaterialBinding.currentnessRule: PDP-0 source currentness for the decision-log contribution is evaluated only against the exact PXD-225 semantic-section selector and its owner-current status pin. New authority sections do not make PXD-225 current by themselves. A changed PXD-225 section requires its owning source-currentness refresh; the whole-file hash remains a transaction preimage only.
recommendedVersionedMaterialBinding.noArbitraryAppendRule: Only the four profile-fixed authority decision selectors, with the exact expected role/order, schema, candidate/freeze pins and record-chain digests, are recognized. Extra, duplicate, unknown, malformed, or caller-selected PXD sections cannot satisfy admission.
versioningAndReviewOrder: Keep R9-R08 candidate/freeze v1 unchanged and pending its distinct full semantic review.

Freeze a new application-profile/material-binding v2 that pins the exact R9-R08 artifacts and the PXD-225 semantic-section fingerprint while classifying the v1 whole-file hash as historical capture provenance.
Complete the distinct full R08 semantic review against exact candidate and v2 profile digests before owner adoption is considered.

Only authentic source owner, root authority, profile authority, and distinct apply authority may create their ordered records through the existing trusted workflow; this recommendation creates none of them.

verificationPlanForImplementer: With all four authentic sections present, the PXD-225 status pin remains exactly the section fingerprint and is not compared to the whole-file digest.
A prepared apply plan contains the final seven-file read set; appending or editing any decision-log bytes after preparation causes the under-lease comparison to reject before effects.
Changing PXD-225 causes the section-currentness guard to fail even if a new whole-file hash is supplied.

A duplicate or fifth candidate-selected authority section, wrong role/order, stale authority record digest, wrong candidate/freeze, stale H review, or substituted target causes denial before any write.
The write journal and readback still cover exactly the existing four allowlisted source targets; the decision log is read-only during canonical apply.
